theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q), IsOpen U → IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → ∃ L : Eucl P → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q), (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∀ Tx : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x Tx → ∀ v ∈ Tx, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f (x + t • v)) (L x v) 0) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable L ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) ∧ ∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ M ∩ K, ‖L x‖ ≤ C
